tech-stack-fingerprint.content: Tech stack fingerprint for ACorp (Vuln Blazor) - ASP.NET Core Blazor WebAssembly app with ServiceStack backend, Vue.js client library, GraphQL API, and Swagger UI. Running on Kestrel/.NET 10/macOS. Auth via ASP.NET Core Identity with antiforgery protection. Secure routes under /secure/ prefix.

auth-session-analysis.content:
Authentication and session analysis for http://127.0.0.1:5000 (Vuln Blazor)

AUTHENTICATION MECHANISM:
- Type: ASP.NET Core Identity (form-based)
- Backend: ServiceStack with Identity authentication realm
- Server: Kestrel (ASP.NET Core)
- No OAuth/external providers configured (placeholder present but no services)

COOKIE NAMES AND PROPERTIES:
- .AspNetCore.Antiforgery.[GUID]: Antiforgery token cookie (httponly, samesite=strict, no Secure flag)
- .AspNetCore.Cookies: Session/authentication cookie (set after login, properties not fully observed)

SESSION REPRESENTATION:
- ASP.NET Core Identity cookie-based authentication
- Uses opaque session cookies (not JWT)
- Claims-based identity via ASP.NET Core Identity framework

CSRF PROTECTION:
- Present: __RequestVerificationToken hidden field in all forms
- POST requests without valid antiforgery token trigger InvalidOperationException in ServiceStack
- Tested: POST to /login without token caused server error

AUTHENTICATION ENDPOINTS:
- /Account/Login: GET (login form), POST (authenticate with email/password)
- /Account/Register: GET (registration form), POST (create account with email/password/confirmPassword)
- /Account/Logout: POST (logout)
- /Account/ForgotPassword: GET (form), POST (password reset request)
- /Account/ResendEmailConfirmation: GET (form), POST (resend confirmation)
- /Account/Manage: Account management pages (ChangePassword, ResetAuthenticator, ExternalLogins, etc.)
- /Account/AccessDenied: Access denied page (200 OK)
- /Account/ExternalLogin: External login callback (302 redirect)
- /Account/ExternalLoginCallback: External login callback (302 redirect)
- /Account/ConfirmEmail: Email confirmation (302 redirect)
- /auth: 302 redirect to /Account/Login with WWW-Authenticate header
- /auth/logout: 302 redirect (logout handler)
- /Auth/Logout: 302 redirect (logout handler)

PROTECTED RESOURCES:
- /secure/bookings: Redirects to /Account/Login?ReturnUrl=... when unauthenticated
- Profile, Bookings, Coupons sections in navigation suggest authenticated-only areas

AUTH FORM FIELDS:
- Login: Input.Email, Input.Password, Input.RememberMe (checkbox)
- Register: Input.Email, Input.Password, Input.ConfirmPassword
- ForgotPassword: Input.Email
- All forms include: _handler (hidden), __RequestVerificationToken (hidden)

AUTH HEADERS:
- WWW-Authenticate: identity realm="/auth/identity" (on /auth and protected endpoints)
- No Bearer/Token auth endpoints found (/api/auth/*, /oauth/token all return 404)

SECURITY OBSERVATIONS:
- CSRF protection is properly implemented
- No JWT/token-based auth exposed via API endpoints
- No external authentication services configured
- ServiceStack middleware processes requests before ASP.NET Core Identity handlers

- /css -> /css/

- /img -> /img/
- /cs -> /cs/

PARAMETERS OBSERVED:

- ServiceStack API uses RESTful paths and supports JSON/XML
- Authentication via ASP.NET Core Identity with ServiceStack integration

NOTES:
- Application is ASP.NET Core Blazor WebAssembly SPA with ServiceStack backend
- Server: Kestrel
- No robots.txt or sitemap.xml found
- Catch-all route returns SPA shell for unknown paths
- /up is a health check endpoint
